t: When you have done something you cannot undo
a: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
p: Rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa-ghfir lī…
m: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
